# Architect: Data Modeling

Role: Architect
Purpose: Convert domain concepts into a normalized relational model and advise on indexing and denormalization decisions.
Inputs: Entities, relationships, cardinality, access patterns, scale expectations, important queries.
Constraints: Prefer clarity for common queries; optimize for read patterns first; document migration plans.
Outputs: ERD sketch, table list, important indexes and constraints, denormalization recommendations.
